page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5g.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs utilizing an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance includes 1919 GB of local SSD storage bundled directly with the hardware configuration. For network connectivity, the server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators.

The integration of high-capacity local SSD storage alongside dedicated Intel Xeon processing cores offers a balanced resource profile for workloads requiring high-speed local data access without the overhead of external storage attachments. This configuration is suitable for database hosting, storage-intensive applications, and general-purpose enterprise workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and local solid-state storage.
